Title: 1898 - War for our World
Author: Steve
Description:
Two start scenarios set on 1 January 1898, the year H. G. Wells published The War of the Worlds.

- Adds 1898 scenarios for a Wells-esque world
- 52 sovereign states and a fully colonial map. The British Empire holds 93 of the 363 regions, 86 of them colonial.
- World economy at two percent of the present-day figure, distributed by the 1900 GDP shares from the Maddison Project. No nuclear weapons, no space budget, no human habitats.
- Triple Alliance, Franco-Russian Alliance and the Union of Sweden and Norway as federations. Austria-Hungary is split into its two halves.
- A Mars variant where the invaders come from Mars as in Wells, with their headquarters on Olympus Mons and their station in low Mars orbit.
- Don't ask me how it is possible that councilors can move that quick without actual planes. They just can. They fly now.

Adds two scenarios and changes nothing in existing campaigns.
